title: Gems of Bali | Temple Trails and Sunset Sails
highlights: Discover Bali, from its lush landscapes and vibrant traditions to its stunning beaches and serene temples.
Visit Uluwatu Temple, perched on dramatic sea cliffs, and enjoy breathtaking ocean views.
Feel the thrill of the giant Bali Jungle Swing, soaring high above lush landscapes for a heart-pounding adventure and unforgettable views.
Treat yourself to a luxurious Balinese spa experience, featuring a soothing Thalasso foot wash and a relaxing massage to refresh your body and mind.
Enjoy a delightful sunset dinner cruise, featuring live music and vibrant DJ sets as you sail along Bali’s beautiful coastline.
overview:
About the Tour:
A land of scenic beaches, serene coastline, temples, lush green rice terraces, charming waterfalls and so much more, Bali is one of the most popular tourist destinations. Embark on this amazing tour to Bali to spend time while exploring this tropical paradise that also offers a plethora of adventure activities. From witnessing the Balinese culture to tasting one of the costliest coffee in the world, this tour will have something special for everyone. Also, the water sports activities, turtle island tour, and the iconic Bali swing are sure to satiate the adventurer in you.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Kuta | Day at Leisure
days.desc: Welcome to Bali, ‘The Land of the Gods’! Upon arrival at the airport, you’ll be driven to your hotel in Kuta. Check in and enjoy the rest of the day at leisure. You can explore various sites such as the Ground Zero Monument or the Kuta Beach Sea Turtle Conservation. In the evening, you can watch a mesmerizing cultural performance at Kuta Theater or explore the Kuta Art Market for shopping. Later, return to the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Bali Temple Tour with Monkey Forest
days.desc: Board the transfer to explore Bali’s most iconic temples. Start with Taman Ayun Temple, known for its beautiful gardens and traditional Balinese architecture. Continue to Tanah Lot Temple, followed by Uluwatu Temple, situated on the southwestern tip of the Bukit Peninsula, offering breathtaking cliffside views. You can also attend the Kecak dance performance at sunset (at your own cost). Afterwards, visit Padang Padang Beach and Alas Kedaton before being driven back to the hotel

days.title: Water Sports at Tanjung Benoa Beach | Sunset Dinner Cruise
days.desc: In the morning, board the transfer to Tanjung Benoa Beach for an exhilarating day of water sports. Enjoy thrilling activities such as banana boat rides, parasailing and jet skiing. Later, get driven to embark on a Sunset Dinner Cruise, where you can indulge in a delectable BBQ dinner. While on board, enjoy exciting entertainment including live music, dazzling cabaret performances and lively DJ sets. After a memorable evening, get transferred back to your hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Transfer to Ubud | Central Bali Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: Today, you’ll check out from the hotel and get driven to Ubud. En route,  Kintamani Highlands to marvel at the stunning views of Mount Batur. Next, visit a local coffee plantation to discover the coffee-making process. Continue to Tegenungan Waterfall, where you can take a refreshing dip in the natural pool. Explore the Tegalalang Rice Terrace, renowned for its beautiful terraced fields and later, experience the thrill of the giant Bali Jungle Swing. Continue to your hotel in Ubud and check in.

days.title: Balinese Spa Experience | Leisure Day
days.desc: In the morning, enjoy a rejuvenating Balinese spa experience, beginning with a soothing Thalasso foot wash and followed by a relaxing massage. After your spa session, you'll be driven back to the hotel. You can spend the rest of the day at leisure, exploring attractions such as Waterbom Waterpark, the bird park, and Ubud Water Palace. In the evening, you can visit the vibrant Ubud Art Market for some shopping. Later, return to the hotel for an overnight stay.
